author: Carrie Williams
text: I had a great experience with Allen Turner’s Septic Service. They were incredibly responsive—quick to return calls and schedule service. Every member of the team that came out was kind, professional, and courteous from start to finish. They handled the repair efficiently and kept me informed throughout the process. It’s so nice to work with a company that values both quality service and customer care. Highly recommend!

author: Rick Seeber
text: Keith was great to work with as was the entire crew! I highly recommend them and will use them again when needed. We really appreciate the excellent service. Thank you to Keith and the crew at Allen Turner Septic Tank. I only leave reviews when my expectations are exceeded.

author: Kelly Smith
text: My septic tank was a complete disaster. The tank was bad, filled lines and the soil was all bad.  The health department said everything had to be replaced and I had to have a  pump now. I called every septic tank repair company  in Mobile.   Mr. Turner gave me the best price.  He also said he could do the repairs within a week. Some companies had me waiting over two weeks. He also explained everything to me.  He helped my stress level go down tremendously.   He worked professionally and efficient. He ran into a lot of problems like a buried pool. He worked around the clock in over  95° weather.  I am so glad that I called him. I would definitely recommend him.

author: Anna L
text: Keith was absolutely wonderful to work with and got my septic tank installed quick despite bad weather conditions. Low and reasonable prices, quick responses, and very friendly. I highly recommend him!

author: Sean W Dickens
